{{Short description|Italian-Swiss physicist (born 1969)}}

'''Luciana Vaccaro''' (born August 27, 1969 in [[Geneva]]), is an [[Italy|Italian]]-[[Switzerland|Swiss]] [[physicist]]. She has held the position of rector of the [[University of Applied Sciences and Arts of Western Switzerland]] since October 2013.

== Early life ==
At the age of 3 months, Vaccaro went to live in [[Naples]], Italy. At the age of 10, after her parents separated, she continued to live with her father, a university professor.<ref name=":0">{{Cite journal |last= |year=2013 |title=Luciana Vaccaro mène "trois vies en parallèle" |url=http://www.letemps.ch/suisse/2013/12/08/luciana-vaccaro-mene-trois-vies-parallele |journal=Le Temps |language= |issue= |page= |issn=}}</ref>

== Education ==
She graduated in physics from the [[University of Naples Federico II]] in 1996. After an internship at [[CERN]], she then went to study at the [[École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne|Swiss Federal Institute of Technology in Lausanne]] and obtained a doctorate in microtechnology in November 2000 in the subject of local probe microscopy on lipid membranes,<ref>{{Cite thesis |year=2000 |title=Local probe microscopy on lipid membranes |url=http://www.infoscience.epfl.ch/record/32742 |journal=Infoscience |doi=10.5075/epfl-thesis-2266 |access-date=2016-03-29 |last1=Vaccaro |first1=Luciana }}</ref> under Fabienne Marquis Weible.

== Career ==
From 2000 to 2006, she was a senior lecturer at the Institute of Nano-Optics of the [[University of Neuchâtel]], at the research centre of René Dändliker. She was responsible for setting up [[Interreg]] European Territorial Cooperation projects with France and was in charge of the “Highlights in Microtechnology” summer school project in microtechnology.<ref>{{Cite web |date= |title=L'Union européenne soutient l'école d'été neuchâteloise en microtechnique |url=http://www2.unine.ch/unine/page-12178.html |access-date= |website= |language=}}</ref>

From 2006 to 2009, she was responsible for directing an MAS (Master of Advanced Studies) programme at the Institute of Health Economics and Management at the [[University of Lausanne]], and worked on issues regarding university training in [[health economics]].<ref name=":0"/>

From 2009 to 2013, she founded and managed the Grant Office at the Swiss Federal Institute of Technology in Lausanne, which aims to help and advise academics seeking research funding.<ref name=":1">{{Cite journal |last= |year=2013 |title=HES-SO: une énergie vouée à l'innovation |url=http://www.hebdo.ch/hebdo/actuels/detail/hes-so-une-%C3%A9nergie-vou%C3%A9e-%C3%A0-l%E2%80%99innovation |journal=L'Hebdo |language= |issue= |page= |issn=}}</ref>

On 1 October 2013, she became the first female rector at the head of the University of Applied Sciences and Arts of Western Switzerland,<ref name=":2">{{Cite journal |last= |year=2013 |title=Luciana Vaccaro, une pionnière à la tête de la HES-SO |url=http://www.bilan.ch/economie/luciana-vaccaro-une-pionniere-la-tete-de-la-hes-so |journal=Bilan |language= |issue= |page= |issn=}}</ref> which comprises 28 institutions of higher education spread across seven cantons, with more than 20,000 students, including 5,700 in Geneva and 7,800 in the canton of Vaud. The Governing Committee reappointed her in 2017 and 2021, each time for four-year terms.

In 2014, she was appointed president of the board of the ''Espace des inventions'' foundation, a science museum located in Lausanne.<ref>{{Cite web |date= |title=A propos de nous |url=http://www.espace-des-inventions.ch/#!fondation/c1v7o |access-date= |website=Espace des inventions |language=}}</ref>

She has sat on the Executive Committee of the [[Swiss National Science Foundation]]<ref>{{Cite web |date=2015-04-08 |title=Élection de Luciana Vaccaro au Comité du Conseil de fondation du FNS |url=http://www.snf.ch/fr/pointrecherche/newsroom/Pages/news-150408-election-de-luciana-vaccaro-au-comite-du-conseil-de-fondation-du-fns.aspx |access-date= |website=Fonds National Suisse de la Recherche Scientifique |language=}}</ref> since 2015 as a representative of the Rectors’ Conference of [[Vocational university|UAS]] (Universities of Applied Sciences and Arts). She has sat on the Board of Directors of Innosuisse<ref>{{Cite web |last=SA |first=Agefi |date=2018-11-08 |title=Luciana Vaccaro prend place au Conseil d'administration d'Innosuisse |url=http://www.agefi.com/home/entreprises/detail/edition/online/article/la-rectrice-de-la-hes-so-haute-ecole-specialisee-de-suisse-occidentale-entre-au-conseil-dadministration-dinnosuisse-482807.html |access-date= |website=www.agefi.com |language=fr}}</ref> since November 2018, and has been vice-president since April 2019.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Luciana Vaccaro élue à la vice-présidence d'Innosuisse {{!}} HES⁠-⁠SO Haute école spécialisée de Suisse occidentale |url=https://www.hes-so.ch/fr/luciana-vaccaro-elue-vice-presidence-dinnosuisse-13762.html |access-date=2020-03-24 |website=www.hes-so.ch}}</ref> She was appointed president of the chamber of UAS of Swiss universities in March 2021. In October 2022 she was elected as the new president of [[Swissuniversities]]. Her mandate starts in February 2023.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Luciana Vaccaro elected as new president of swissuniversities |url=https://www.swissuniversities.ch/en/organisation/documentation/press-releases/luciana-vaccaro-elected-as-new-president-of-swissuniversities |access-date=2022-11-15 |website=www.swissuniversities.ch |date=20 October 2022 |language=it-CH}}</ref>

In November 2022, she received the medal of [[Legion of Honour|Chevalier de la Légion d'Honneur]] from the French ambassador in Bern.<ref>{{Cite web |title= La dernière fois que j'ai été aussi émue, c'était pour mon (...) |url=https://ch.ambafrance.org/La-derniere-fois-que-j-ai-ete-aussi-emue-c-etait-pour-mon-diplome |access-date=2022-12-19 |website=La France en Suisse et au Liechtenstein |language=fr}}</ref>
